review_type: Independent mathematical/source review with small structural controls
verdict: PASS within the stated arithmetic-program scope; no binary TM state bound

structural_controls.edge_orientation_lifts: both directions and phases, including equal endpoints

mathematical_obligations.ground_completeness: All ground contextual instances generate the ground equational congruence; each directed edge is implemented by a total endpoint transposition.
mathematical_obligations.word_coverage: Canonical address 1 0 1^i1 ... 0 1^ik has depth sum(ij+1). All finite words are reached at finite stage.
mathematical_obligations.edge_inverse: Right edge executes j then j+1; its return executes j+1 then j. Empty-word right edges are identities.
mathematical_obligations.restoration: Vertex invariant plus return to root gives exact restoration. The same proof applies to (term,phase).
mathematical_obligations.call_count: 2(2^D-1) left calls plus 4(2^D-1-D) right calls gives 6(2^D-1)-4D; stated cumulative sum agrees.
mathematical_obligations.threshold: For B=2^D and positive heap vertex v, v<B iff its depth is below D. At root completion B doubles and direction resets.
mathematical_obligations.counter_scope: Core persistent traversal data B,v,direction; arithmetic scratch, term/phase data, and optional Python swap/report/budget metadata are additional. Vertex is unbounded path storage.
mathematical_obligations.initial_and_empty_words: Initial equality test handles the root and empty proof. An edge with zero calls leaves an already-tested value unchanged.
mathematical_obligations.phase_lift: F flips phase; J_e exchanges exactly (a_e,0) and (b_e,1), even when a_e=b_e. Other states are fixed. Projected orbit is exactly the ordinary orbit.
mathematical_obligations.phase_weight: Generator e+1 has weight e+2; at most one weight-1 phase flip per original step yields sum(e+3).
mathematical_obligations.query_interface: Explicitly conditional: an actual fixed ZFC-calibrated query and its writer/simulation remain to be emitted and proved.

limits: Ordinary mathematical/source review, not a proof-assistant kernel check.
Did not rerun the author's large finite model or exhaustive involution suites.
Structural controls support implementation agreement; arbitrary-depth claims use the supplied mathematical induction, not finite tests.
No independent re-verification of the published first-order-to-Df3 theorem or prior E7 reduction in this controller audit.
No compiled binary machine, actual ZFC query term, or state-saving claim follows from this audit.
